feeds.title: Garden Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2010 by Stephanie Rose, Garden Therapy is a blog that focuses on gardening and DIY projects that promote wellness and healing. The blog offers a variety of articles, tutorials, and resources for gardeners of all levels. Stephanie Rose is a gardening expert and author who is passionate about helping people find joy and healing through gardening.

feeds.title: Horticultural Therapy Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Horticultural Therapy Institute is a non-profit organization that provides education and training for horticultural therapists. Their blog offers insights into the field of horticultural therapy, as well as tips and resources for horticultural therapists and gardeners.

feeds.title: Cliff Thorbes, Horticultural Therapist Blog
feeds.description: Cliff Thorbes is a horticultural therapist based in Canada. His blog offers insights into the field of horticultural therapy, as well as tips and resources for gardeners and therapists. Cliff Thorbes' blog aims to educate and inspire readers about the benefits of horticultural therapy, a field that uses gardening and plant-related activities to promote mental and physical wellness.

feeds.title: Horticulture For Healing
feeds.description: Founded by Kathy Jentz, Horticulture For Healing is a non-profit organization that offers horticultural therapy programs to veterans and people with disabilities. Their blog offers updates on their programs and events, as well as insights into the benefits of horticultural therapy.

feeds.title: The Therapy Garden Blog
feeds.description: The Therapy Garden is a UK-based charity that offers horticultural therapy programs to people with disabilities and mental health issues. Their blog offers updates on their programs and events, as well as insights into the benefits of horticultural therapy.

feeds.description: Garden Therapy Blog is run by Tammie Marsh, a gardening enthusiast and proprietor of Garden Therapy based in Kentucky.
